facts.KSC Series, p. B-51 (Sealed Tact Switch: SPST N.O.; J bend and gullwing SMT terminals; IP67 except KSC5 (IP50). Electrical, silver / gold: max power 1 VA / 0.2 VA; max 32 VDC; min voltage 20 mV; max current 50 mA / 10 mA; min current 1 mA / 0.1 mA; bounce <= 1 ms; contact resistance <= 100 mOhm. Operating temperature silver -40 to 85 C, gold -40 to 125 C. Reflow per IEC 61760-1.
facts.KSC Product Range, p. B-51: KSC2 soft actuator H 3.5 mm IP67; KSC3 hard actuator H 3.5 mm IP67
facts.KSC Series common footprint page, p. B-5: J bend: terminal span 6.8 mm, pad layout 8.6 min / 3 max; G gullwing: span 10 (7.6), pad layout 12 min / 5.8 max. The same J and G drawings serve KSC1-KSC10; reels: KSC2G and KSC3G 2,000 per 16 mm reel
facts.KSC2 Series, p. B-54: KSC201 1.6 +/- 0.6 N, 5,000,000 ops, travel 0.3 +/- 0.2; KSC221 2 +/- 0.5 N, 500,000, 0.35 +0.3/-0.1; KSC222 2 +/- 0.5 N, 1,000,000, 0.35 +/- 0.15; KSC241 3.5 +/- 0.9 N, 300,000, 0.5 +/- 0.2. Ordering: KSC2 | force 0=1.6 N, 2=2 N, 4=3.5 N, 5=5.5 N | contact 1 silver, 2 silver long life, 3 gold, 4 gold long life | J or G | LFS silver plated, LFG gold plated
